## Run A

1. Parse `112 101` as a typed set, preserving that order. Read `$PROCEDURE_ROOT/reference/batch.md`, where `PROCEDURE_ROOT` is the installed skill directory supplied by runtime metadata.

2. Run `git remote get-url origin`. It returns `git@github.com:acme/widgets.git`. Read the active pi-cohort configuration: `parallel.maxTasks` is 4. Admit both PRs: pi supports the set, its two entries fit the cap, and there are no duplicate identities or positional issue references.

3. Read `$PROCEDURE_ROOT/reference/post-selection-loop.md`'s continuation-record procedure. Mint the parent run folder and initialize its continuation record before creating its roster or initializing tracking.

4. Run these metadata commands in argument order:

   `gh pr view 112 --json number,author,headRefOid,headRefName,baseRefName,isCrossRepository,headRepository,state,files,url,title,body,additions,deletions,closingIssuesReferences,reviewRequests --jq '(.linearRefs = [(.title + " " + (.body // "")) | scan("https://linear\\.app/([A-Za-z0-9-]+)/issue/([A-Za-z][A-Za-z0-9]+-[0-9]+)(?:[^A-Za-z0-9_-]|$)") | {key: .[0], id: (.[1] | ascii_upcase)}]) | .body |= (. // "")[0:300]'`

   `gh pr view 101 --json number,author,headRefOid,headRefName,baseRefName,isCrossRepository,headRepository,state,files,url,title,body,additions,deletions,closingIssuesReferences,reviewRequests --jq '(.linearRefs = [(.title + " " + (.body // "")) | scan("https://linear\\.app/([A-Za-z0-9-]+)/issue/([A-Za-z][A-Za-z0-9]+-[0-9]+)(?:[^A-Za-z0-9_-]|$)") | {key: .[0], id: (.[1] | ascii_upcase)}]) | .body |= (. // "")[0:300]'`

5. Read the viewer and memberships once:

   `gh api user --jq .login`

   `gh api user/teams --paginate --jq '.[] | .organization.login + "/" + .slug'`

6. Resolve ticket-display configuration, in order:

   `git symbolic-ref --short refs/remotes/origin/HEAD`

   `git show origin/main:.pi/gauntlet-overrides.md`

   `git show origin/main:gauntlet-overrides.md`

   `git show origin/main:doc/gauntlet-overrides.md`

   No tracker override applies. PR #112 links directly to issue #22; PR #101's branch identifies issue #45. No Linear lookup runs.

7. Emit the typed roster in input order, attached to the assessment-procedure read:

---
**PRs to gate:**
- [#112](https://github.com/acme/widgets/pull/112) +300 -80, by pat, [#22](https://github.com/acme/widgets/issues/22) - centralize settings reads through one resolver
- [#101](https://github.com/acme/widgets/pull/101) +3 -1, yours, [#45](https://github.com/acme/widgets/issues/45) - raise the default retry timeout
---
Paired call: `cat "$PROCEDURE_ROOT/reference/assessment.md"`

**Next step:** serial provisioning in roster order, #112 then #101. Stop before its fetch or worktree creation. No helpers have been dispatched, and no per-PR Gather stages have started; the parent tracker uses `pr-112 state: <RUN_DIR>/pr-112/state` and `pr-101 state: <RUN_DIR>/pr-101/state`, not single-PR stage tasks.

## Run B:
```bash
gh pr view https://github.com/acme/gadgets/pull/97 --json number,title,body,author,state,isDraft,headRefName,baseRefName,isCrossRepository,mergeable,headRefOid,statusCheckRollup,files,additions,deletions,commits,reviews,closingIssuesReferences,reviewDecision,headRepository,maintainerCanModify,mergeStateStatus,url,mergeCommit,reviewRequests
gh api user --jq .login
gh api user/teams --paginate --jq '.[] | .organization.login + "/" + .slug'
git symbolic-ref --short refs/remotes/origin/HEAD
git show origin/main:.pi/gauntlet-overrides.md
git show origin/main:gauntlet-overrides.md
git show origin/main:doc/gauntlet-overrides.md
```

The single typed URL selects `acme/gadgets` for subsequent GitHub calls; the set-only origin-match restriction does not reject it. Section A is already in context, and no ticket reference is found.

---
**PR to gate:**
- [#97](https://github.com/acme/gadgets/pull/97) +40 -12, by robin, requested from you, no ticket - add a csv export button for the widget list
---
Paired call: `gh run list -R acme/gadgets -c cccccccccccccccccccccccccccccccccccccccc --json databaseId,status,conclusion,workflowName,url`

1. Retain that Actions-run result. Read the continuation-record procedure, mint the run folder, and initialize its continuation record before tracker initialization. Initialize the tracker with `gather`, `provision`, and `verify`; start `gather`. There is no `sync` stage because the invocation has no `--rebase`.

2. Continue Gather without repeating the preamble or Actions-run listing. Run:

   `gh api graphql -f query='query($o:String!,$r:String!,$n:Int!){ repository(owner:$o,name:$r){ viewerPermission pullRequest(number:$n){ viewerCanUpdateBranch viewerCanMergeAsAdmin viewerCanClose headRefOid body baseRefName } } }' -f o=acme -f r=gadgets -F n=97`

   `gh repo view acme/gadgets --json nameWithOwner`

   `gh pr diff https://github.com/acme/gadgets/pull/97`

   `gh api repos/acme/gadgets/pulls/97/reviews --paginate`

   `gh api repos/acme/gadgets/pulls/97/comments --paginate`

   `gh api repos/acme/gadgets/issues/97/comments --paginate`

   `git worktree list --porcelain`

3. Assemble the Gather digest, retaining the supplied head `cccccccccccccccccccccccccccccccccccccccc`, the GitHub results, comments, permissions, and worktree discovery. No supplied comment requires a reviewer-run lookup. Complete `gather`.

**Next step:** step 2, Provision + configure, beginning with the assessment-procedure read. Stop before provisioning. No helper has been dispatched and no verification has run; subsequent verification and review must assess `cccccccccccccccccccccccccccccccccccccccc` unless the prescribed workflow detects a head change. No report or menu is rendered at this entry's stopping point.
